citation.authors: Cliff J, Muquingue H, Nhassico D, Nzwalo H et al

cited_by.title: Plantain, yam and cassava: blood sugar and safety

record.population: Communities in Mozambique with epidemics of konzo, a paralysis linked to cassava
record.design: Review of epidemics and cyanide measurements
record.finding: Konzo epidemics came at times of drought, war or crisis when people depended on insufficiently processed bitter cassava; mostly women of child-bearing age and children were affected, with high thiocyanate in blood or urine. Prevention focused on less toxic cassava varieties and processing methods such as grating and flour wetting.
record.note: About bitter cassava in food-insecure settings; it is not about sweet cassava cooked normally.
